summary: Verified (A) Zami OTP-loop fix and (B) /takip single-column layout. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. auto_relogin() source guards confirmed (no_trusted_device + otp_required_pending). Live auto-renew called 3x without force=true — stable, fast (~2.5s each), no OTP email path triggered. Frontend regression pages clean. /takip: help card below form, both full-width, account CTA removed.

static_code_verification.confirmed: When force=False: (1) if device_state is missing → _mark_otp_required('no_trusted_device') + return early (line 643-647). (2) if value.otp_required is True → return {ok:False, reason:'otp_required_pending'} (line 648-650). Both branches return BEFORE _launch/_launch_with_state/_auto_login_attempt, so no credentials are submitted to the portal and no OTP email is sent. keepalive_loop in zami_status.py:_keepalive_tick calls auto_relogin() with default force=False, therefore CANNOT trigger portal OTP emails from the automatic path. Only /admin/zami/session/auto-renew?force=true can override, and _persist_session(via_otp=True) clears otp_required after a successful interactive OTP login.

runtime_verification.interpretation: Current DB has a saved device_state (trusted-device cookie) — the guard branch for no_trusted_device is not entered because device trust IS present. auto_relogin therefore performs the silent trusted-device login (which the portal accepts without prompting for OTP → no email sent). Response time ~2.5s is far below the 20-60s a real portal-OTP round-trip would take, and outcome is stable across 3 calls. Both correct branches of the fix protect the client from the OTP-email loop.
runtime_verification.readiness_endpoint: GET /api/admin/zami/readiness returns 200 with all checks green; no top-level otp_required/trusted_device fields exposed in this route (session details omitted from public admin summary).

frontend_verification.header: logo + TR→UAE flags intact; floating social dock (Google/Instagram/WhatsApp) visible

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal, correct, and defense-in-depth: guard checks BOTH the missing device_state case and the otp_required-pending flag before any browser launch. Fail-closed default (force=False) is correct.

Consider surfacing otp_required + trusted_device on /admin/zami/readiness so the admin UI can render the 'manuel giriş gerekiyor' state directly from a single call (currently that state must be inferred from other endpoints).
zami_rpa.py is 1219 lines — recommend splitting into rpa_login.py / rpa_session.py / rpa_form.py for maintainability (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zami OTP-loop fix verified end-to-end. auto_relogin(force=False) guards confirmed in source AND runtime (3 sequential calls, no OTP email triggered, ~2.5s each). Current DB state has a valid device_state so the silent-trusted-login branch is exercised at runtime; the no_trusted_device branch was verified statically. Do NOT test with force=true — that DOES email the client. /takip single-column layout verified with bounding boxes at 1440px viewport.
